runs.title: Reply before timeout
runs.description: Two client occurrences run independently. A second release of first.poll waits for its serial lock.

runs.title: Timeout and late reply
runs.description: The request expires at 20 ms. Later replies are discarded and cannot resume the caller.

runs.title: Open at the horizon
runs.description: The observation ends at 3 ms while callers await responses and one release awaits dispatch.

runs.title: Declared deadline missed
runs.description: The queued second activation cannot finish by its 31 ms deadline. The run stops with the pending intervals still open.
